They can be linked to such tools as CRMs, Google Sheets, Slack, or emails. With triggers and actions (Zaps), you can keep all of your steps in the origination process in communication (inquiry to close) in the tools you use regularly. Can Encompass integrate directly with Zapier? Yes, it can—though not natively. Generally, you will be accessing Encompass API integration Zapier via Developer Connect APIs with or without the assistance of a middleware product, such as Zapier Webhooks or homemade Zaps. These allow Encompass to push or pull data to/from third party tools securely so you can create automated workflows on multiple platforms and do so with little or no code. Which APIs are used to integrate Encompass with Zapier? The integration focuses mostly on Encompass Developer Connect APIs which are RESTful APIs that can give access to loan files, borrower information, documents and milestones. It is possible to connect such APIs to Zapier for loan origination workflow automation using Webhooks, authentication via OAuth 2.0, and Zapier’s built-in app connectors. Further complex cases might be still required to use middleware or scripting and collaboration with both LOS and automation team will allow avoiding errors. Is the integration secure and compliant with mortgage regulations? Yes, assuming it is done right, the salesforce encompass integration can be secure and compliant. Encompass APIs use OAuth for authentication, and provide secure data transfer. Salesforce also has enterprise-level security practices. Following the best approaches, being compliant with regulations, such as GLBA and CFPB guidelines, requires encryption, audit logging and user access control within the integration.
